name: Teen Performance Ensemble (Prince George's County Parks and Recreation)
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
city: College Park, MD (auditions); Prince George's County, MD
what_you_do: Join a six week summer touring production of an original play. It performs for M-NCPPC summer camps. There is a public show at the end. You rehearse weekly starting in April 2027.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 16 to 18 who pass the audition.
pay_detail: Paid, part time. The pay rate is not stated on the page.
duration: Weekly rehearsals starting April 2027 and a summer performance schedule from June 28 to August 6, 2027.
deadline_text: Auditions are on Sunday, February 7, 2027 at 3 p.m. at the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center (8270 Alumni Dr, College Park).
how_to_apply: Attend the audition on February 7, 2027 at 3 p.m. Questions go to megan.merchant@pgparks.com. The audition event page was not available when checked, so ask for audition details (what to prepare) by email.
notes: Maryland Department of Labor says work permits are required for all minors under 18 to work in Maryland. A permit is issued only after the minor is offered a job. Confirm first. The page lists the audition but not what to prepare.
